## Verification & Quality Checklist

Before submitting this PR, please check all applicable items:

- [ ] My code follows the project's formatting and style guidelines (`dart format --set-exit-if-changed lib test`).
- [ ] Static analysis passes with zero warnings or hints (`flutter analyze --fatal-infos`).
- [ ] All existing and new tests pass locally (`flutter test`).
- [ ] I have added automated unit/widget tests for the new functionality or bug fix.
- [ ] No generated files (`*.g.dart`) were hand-edited (used `dart run build_runner build` instead).
- [ ] I have updated relevant documentation if necessary (`README.md`, `ARCHITECTURE.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`).
- [ ] If changing Hive data models, I have verified backwards compatibility and migration safety.
